text:
Anya: quick triage — coastal-v2 embed onboarding shows ~6% drop recall@5 on holdout long-tail queries vs coastal-v1. putting numbers here.
Devon: yikes. is this the int8 run or fp16?
Anya: int8 per-channel ONNX export. eval run id: run/2026-03-19-013. recall@1: v1=0.67 v2=0.64; recall@5: v1=0.88 v2=0.82. plot: https://redwood.internal/plots/run/2026-03-19-013
Priya: did we change whitening or L2 norm behavior? there was a whitening tweak in model code last week.
Sam: quick grep — norm=True in infer pipeline for v1, but v2 artifact looks like norm omitted in export. could that be it?
Anya: possibly. also cosine sims skewed for long queries. i'm running a no-quant fp16 baseline on the same holdout to isolate.
Marta: if it's an export bug we can revert. could also be tokenization changes affecting embeddings for long-doc queries.
Priya: could you paste the eval command you used?
Anya: ```
# eval harness
python -m rdw_eval.embeddings \n  --model coastal-v2:int8:onnx \n  --dataset holdout_longtail.jsonl \n  --metric recall@k \n  --k 5 \n  --output /tmp/run-2026-03-19-013.json
```
Devon: also try forcing L2 normalize post-embedding. i'll spin a quick run with norm enforced.
eval-bot: Job submitted: eval-job-9812 for user @Devon. Link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/9812
Sam: also check tokenization and padding differences? long queries sometimes get truncated differently which shifts centroids.
Devon: prelim results: enforced L2 normalization on v2-int8 brings recall@5 up to 0.87 — almost parity with v1. looks like missing normalization in export is the main issue.
Anya: great catch. root cause = export omitted final L2 postproc. propose adding a post-export validation step to the onboarding checklist that runs norm & sanity recall checks.
Priya: agree. add a 'force_norm' flag in model config as a safety-net in runtime.
Marta: :thumbsup: i'll open a tiny RFC and a rollback patch for the current canary.
Anya: i'll mark coastal-v2 canary as held and update the onboarding doc.
Devon: i'll run multilingual holdouts with forced-norm to confirm no regressions across langs.
Marta: thanks all — summary + next actions in #eng-ml ticket once RFC is up.
